description:
Typical cost of a presentation in RUB; nothing is charged and no deck is started.

Presentations are priced by actual usage (the real Claude session cost times rate_rub_per_usd), so there is
no exact quote: typical_cost_rub is the median final cost per tier (fast, pro) over the last 30 days, or null
while there are too few finished decks. Revisions add to the cost of the same presentation. min_balance_rub is
the balance needed to start or continue a presentation of that tier: below it create_presentation and
revise_presentation answer 402 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE (tell the user to top up the balance).

The answer may carry promo: a free period that applies to this caller (the chat on arckep.ru); tell the user
about it in one sentence; without promo the usual price applies. image_price_rub is the price of one slide
picture; pictures are charged apart from the presentation, so give it when the user asks about illustrations.
name: estimate_presentation
